### Download

**[Satsuma-Setup.exe](https://github.com/kalharakeh/satsuma/releases/latest/download/Satsuma-Setup.exe)** is the installer. No admin rights needed, and Python and FFmpeg are bundled.
Satsuma-portable.zip is the same app without an installer. Unzip it and run `Satsuma.exe --install` once.

> Windows SmartScreen may warn because the app isn't code-signed yet: click **More info → Run anyway**.

### What's in 1.0

- **Shift-drag** any file from Explorer or the desktop, then drop it on a format
- ~100 conversions and tools for images, video, audio, PDF, Office files, data and archives
- **Remove background** from photos (local AI model, offline after a one-time download)
- **Subtitles from speech:** turn video or audio into an SRT file and a transcript (Whisper, offline)
- **Text from images and scanned PDFs (OCR):** uses Windows' built-in OCR, with an offline fallback
- **Trim** video and audio, **lock/unlock** PDFs with a password, **batch rename** with a live preview
- **Presets:** your own one-click tiles (e.g. "WEBP, 1600 px, 80%")
- **Watch folders:** new files in a folder get converted automatically
- **Undo:** sends the result to the Recycle Bin, or puts renamed files back
